tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground, everywhere outside the board. Also the ink on bright fills (via on-maze, on-gold).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, modals, the HUD bar, toasts.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, stat cells and secondary buttons, on surface or void.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Meter tracks, sprite stages and the colour of every hard shadow.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The veil over the board behind a modal panel. Replaces the five different overlay blacks.

tokens.name: maze-800
tokens.usage: The theme green (browser chrome, manifest). Panel title strips; pressed secondary buttons.

tokens.name: maze-700
tokens.usage: Wall shade in the tile art. The lip under a primary button; quiet dividers (line-quiet).

tokens.name: maze-600
tokens.usage: Wall mid tone in the tile art. Hover fill of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: maze-500
tokens.usage: Wall face in the tile art. Panel and control borders (line): at least 4:1 on void, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: maze-400
tokens.usage: Wall highlight in the tile art. Primary button fill; carries on-maze text, never white.

tokens.name: teal-700
tokens.usage: Deep shade of the item art.

tokens.name: teal-500
tokens.usage: Mid shade of the item art.

tokens.name: teal-400
tokens.usage: Light shade of the item art.

tokens.name: teal-300
tokens.usage: The item colour: every pickup, the exit, and energy. As text on void, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: energy
tokens.usage: Energy meter fill, energy numbers, Found rarity. Same teal as the energy pickup on the board.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Reward: score, best, new unlocks, earned feats, Rare rarity, the Knot ring. As text on void, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: gold-shade
tokens.usage: Lip under a gold button; shade of gold marks. From the Gold body ramp.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger as text, borders and marks on void, surface, surface-raised: low energy, fatal toll, failed states. The enemy art highlight.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Danger as a fill (the enemy red). Carries on-danger text. Never as text on dark: 3.6:1 only.

tokens.name: feat
tokens.usage: Feat-only rarity and feat unlocks, as text, borders and pips on void, surface, surface-raised. From the Purple body ramp.

tokens.name: feat-shade
tokens.usage: Shade of feat marks. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on void, surface, surface-raised, maze-800 and scrim. Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and labels on void, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Disabled and locked text on void, surface, surface-raised (still 4.5:1).

tokens.name: on-maze
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a maze-400 fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on a gold fill (NEW tag, gold button).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger-fill fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of panels, buttons, cards, meters.

tokens.name: line-quiet
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a panel and borders of disabled or locked things. Decorative: never the only cue.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The 1 art-pixel outline of floor sprites (items, enemies, exit, pickups) and the eye pixel of the reptile.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The countdown and the title on status pages. One per screen.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Mode name, big stat values, toast headline.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Buttons, menu rows, HUD numbers, tags. The smallest Silkscreen size.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: The maze rewires itself around the Knot each time you move.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Gear is kept when you reach the exit; dying loses it.
styles.usage: Default text in panels, settings rows, summaries.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Your wallet pays the network fee.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels over a value: stat names, layer names, rarity.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: One UI pixel: the gap between meter segments, pip gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; between D-pad keys.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row, between stat cells.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Padding inside cards and toasts.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel padding; side padding of buttons; the phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: One tile. Gap between groups inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between a panel title and its body on desktop.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Two tiles. Page margins on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner. Soften a box with a stepped notch (notch-sm, notch-md), never a curve.

tokens.name: lip-maze
tokens.usage: The 4px lip inside the bottom of a primary button (maze-700).

tokens.name: lip-well
tokens.usage: The lip of a secondary button and of D-pad keys (well).

tokens.name: lip-gold
tokens.usage: The lip of a gold (reward) button (gold-shade).

tokens.name: drop-hard
tokens.usage: Toasts and floating cards over the board. Hard offset, zero blur. No glow anywhere.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, meters, toasts: one UI pixel.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Panels, modals, the HUD top edge, an equipped card.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: One board tile at 1x: 24 art pixels. Icons in stat cells and toasts.

tokens.name: tile-2x
tokens.usage: Tile at 2x; the native size of a trait frame PNG; the smallest touch target.

tokens.name: tile-3x
tokens.usage: Tile at 3x on large boards.

tokens.name: tile-4x
tokens.usage: Sprite in a trait card (trait frame at 2x).

tokens.name: tile-6x
tokens.usage: Sprite on the wardrobe and mint stage (trait frame at 3x).

tokens.name: dpad-key
tokens.usage: One D-pad key.

tokens.name: notch-sm
tokens.usage: Stepped corner cut of buttons, cards, toasts.

tokens.name: notch-md
tokens.usage: Stepped corner cut of panels and modals.
